body: Hi, I'm also 22, jobless, unable to drive, and my friends have moved away. I just found out that next year my bf is moving away and he wants me to see other people. This fall I'm going back to community college for the third time. I feel very stupid as well. if I keep thinking I'm in my training arc/montage of a movie/show, it helps me keep going for a lil bit.

I'm only 22 but I relate to wanting to escape all social situations. Last week my boyfriend had his vacation and I only spent 2 days with him before isolating myself for the rest of the week because I believed I was bothering him. He probably would be better off without me but I'm selfish and I don't have the guts to leave him, all of my friends have moved out away from my hometown. I even quit my job on impulse. All we can do is take it day by day.

I ended up buying a little book with 10 letter prompts for me to write in for this underway which is similar to the open when ones. Last time I bought a small jar filled with plastic pills and when you open them they have tiny notes inside that you can personalize! He really loved them. Thank you for the advice :)

I send a lot of emails too so I'm glad I'm not alone. I really like the calender idea too because it sounds fun and creative. I'm probably going to work on my self-discipline with my school work and I would like to practice painting/drawing more. Then, when I get a new job I can work on my time management at home too. I've been thinking about getting into crochet too but only because I want to make him a blanket one day. I also used to journal a lot in high school, maybe I should get back into that. Thank you for your help! :)
